finding: renderHealthCoaching carried one unguarded .join(): `chatEsc((c.by || []).join(", "))`. Every other array in that function is guarded with Array.isArray. A `by` arriving as an object or a string — the exact mutation the stress sweep's 'wrong-typed fields' case produces — threw a TypeError inside the renderer; safeRun caught it, so the page stayed up and the card rendered EMPTY with no on-page reason. The defect has never fired for one reason only: the document has never existed. It would have fired on the first real write, i.e. the moment F-P3-02 is fixed.
evidence: Found by execution, not by reading: running the sweep against a scratchpad fixture store containing a healthCoaching document turned the 'Document healthCoaching (malformed input)' row from Pass to 'Degraded — 1 of 7 malformed shapes (wrong-typed fields) reach a renderer and throw: renderHealthCoaching @html:16399'. stress-sweep.js:169-183 flipTypes turns an array into an object. After the one-line guard the same fixture run reports that row as Pass and the sweep as 55 Pass · 0 Degraded · 0 Fail.
fix: Fixed in the deck source at command-deck.html:16399 — `(c.by || [])` became `(Array.isArray(c.by) ? c.by : [])`. One line, no other change. The edit is in the scratchpad deck source only; it is not published and the deck is not committed to this repo. Regression check against the live store after the edit: 344 containers, 0 exceptions, 0 safeRun failures, 0 shape warnings, verdict PASS — identical to before.
